scope: Sanitized project-history export and original pilot release; not biological validation
limitations: Only paths directly referenced by the main progress report, plus explicit retirement evidence, were considered for inclusion.
Full directories, large binary bundles, raw/source data and several other original references remain local-only.

Historical results retain their original study-specific assumptions, status and source licenses.
